summary: Sionna Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing a board-approved restructuring approved September 9, 2026, cutting headcount roughly 46% to concentrate on the SION-451/SION-2222 dual combination program and extend cash runway. The company is winding down the SION-719 add-on program, terminating related clinical and manufacturing vendor pacts. Estimated charges total about $6.4 million: $5.3 million severance and post-employment benefits, $0.7 million contract close-outs, $0.4 million stock compensation, substantially complete by Q3 2026. Chief Business Officer Caroline Stark Beer's employment terminated without cause effective September 15, 2026, triggering Severance Plan benefits. Watch cash runway, execution risk, and any further charges.
